title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 1

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the system-diagram lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The communications engineering tutor will introduce basic system diagrams on Wednesday at ten. Students should meet in the network classroom and bring the labelled diagram from the course folder. The lesson will identify a transmitter, communication channel and receiver. Students will discuss the purpose of each block using a simple example.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which communication-system diagram should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The communications engineering tutor will introduce basic system diagrams on Wednesday at ten. Students should meet in the network classroom and bring the labelled diagram from the course folder. The lesson will identify a transmitter, communication channel and receiver. Students will discuss the purpose of each block using a simple example.
options: The labelled diagram from the course folder

tasks.prompt: A basic communication system transfers information from a source to a destination. A transmitter prepares a signal, a channel carries it and a receiver processes the incoming signal. The system may also include noise or interference that affects the quality of communication. A block diagram helps engineers describe the main functions without showing every internal circuit detail. Reading 1. What does a channel do in a basic communication system?
Why is a block diagram useful?
options: It lists every internal circuit component
It gives the exact physical dimensions
It replaces the need for technical documentation
It describes the main functions without showing every internal circuit detail

tasks.prompt: The signal ___ through the communication channel.
Choose TWO blocks commonly shown in a basic communication-system diagram.
A device that sends a signal into a communication system is a ___.
A diagram does not show the channel clearly. What should you ask?
options: I will guess how the signal travels.
Could you identify the communication channel on the block diagram?

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of communication systems in a logical order.
options: Follow the channel to the receiver
correctOrder: Follow the channel to the receiver

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words describing a basic communication system. Explain the roles of a transmitter, channel and receiver.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the transmitter, channel and receiver are identified (0–2); the response explains the general role of each stage in carrying information from source to destination (0–2); the description is logically organised with understandable grammar (0–2); communication-system vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
